points.en: IPR refers to legal rights given to inventors and creators for their intellectual creations.
points.hi: IPR refers to legal rights given to inventors and creators for their intellectual creations.

points.en: Types: Patents (inventions), Copyrights (literary/artistic works), Trademarks (brand identity), Geographical Indications (origin-based quality).
points.hi: Types: Patents (inventions), Copyrights (literary/artistic works), Trademarks (brand identity), Geographical Indications (origin-based quality).

points.en: TRIPS Agreement (WTO) sets minimum standards for IPR regulation globally.
points.hi: TRIPS Agreement (WTO) sets minimum standards for IPR regulation globally.

points.en: National IPR Policy 2016: 'Creative India; Innovative India'.
points.hi: National IPR Policy 2016: 'Creative India; Innovative India'.

points.en: Nodal Agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).
points.hi: Nodal Agency: Department for Promotion of Industry and Internal Trade (DPIIT).

points.en: Statutory Bodies: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM).
points.hi: Statutory Bodies: Controller General of Patents, Designs and Trademarks (CGPDTM).

question.en: What is the primary objective of the National IPR Policy 2016?
question.hi: What is the primary objective of the National IPR Policy 2016?

answer.en: To stimulate innovation and creativity by creating awareness and strengthening the legal framework.
answer.hi: To stimulate innovation and creativity by creating awareness and strengthening the legal framework.

misconception.en: IPR is only for technology and software.
misconception.hi: IPR is only for technology and software.

correction.en: IPR covers a wide range including artistic works, brand logos, and traditional agricultural products.
correction.hi: IPR covers a wide range including artistic works, brand logos, and traditional agricultural products.

fiveFacts.en: India is a signatory to the TRIPS Agreement.
fiveFacts.hi: India is a signatory to the TRIPS Agreement.

fiveFacts.en: Patents in India are granted for 20 years.
fiveFacts.hi: Patents in India are granted for 20 years.

fiveFacts.en: Copyright protection generally lasts for the lifetime of the author plus 60 years.
fiveFacts.hi: Copyright protection generally lasts for the lifetime of the author plus 60 years.

fiveFacts.en: Geographical Indications are registered under the GI Act, 1999.
fiveFacts.hi: Geographical Indications are registered under the GI Act, 1999.

fiveFacts.en: DPIIT is the nodal department for IPR administration.
fiveFacts.hi: DPIIT is the nodal department for IPR administration.

threeTraps.en: Assuming IPR is only a legal issue; it is a critical economic and trade issue.
threeTraps.hi: Assuming IPR is only a legal issue; it is a critical economic and trade issue.

threeTraps.en: Ignoring the role of international treaties like the Paris Convention.
threeTraps.hi: Ignoring the role of international treaties like the Paris Convention.
